title: DashMap-Tiles index
description: Tracked discovery file the DashMap app fetches to find per-region tile releases.

slug.description: Short region id (e.g. brazil). Lower-case, filesystem-safe.

latest.description: Release tag, convention <CC>-<slug> (stable per region, e.g. BR-sul).

builtAtMs.description: Build timestamp of the currently published release (epoch ms, from its manifest). Lets the app show freshness without fetching every manifest.
